summary: Comprehensive architecture and execution plan for the AI Video Recap, Myanmar Voice Clone, and Motion Studio application. Features Gemini multi-key rotation, FAL AI FLUX image generation, video upload & transcription with timestamps, Edge TTS Thiha & Nilar voices with 0.25s silence trimming, 1.25x frame-lock smart sync, Myanmar on-video subtitles, and Alight Motion style keyframe and effect video editing.
